Specification: This module is a test harness for the ChangRobertsTyped specification, modeling bounded testing scenarios for a typed version of the Chang-Roberts leader-election protocol. It introduces local copies of the constants and variables, bounds the number of nodes with MAX_N, overrides the Node set using N and Id, and defines test predicates for stateless operators, single-step actions, bounded executions, and temporal checks. The file verifies properties such as successor well-formedness, effects of the n0 action on messages, absence of a winner after bounded executions, and correctness under an assumed liveness condition, while relying on an instantiated external module for the actual protocol operators like Init, TypeOK, succ, n0, n1, Liveness, and Correctness.
